parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of durable polycarbonate plastic. It is a long, narrow component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It provides support and stability, holding the glasses in place on the wearer’s head by resting over the ear.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It mirrors the right leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It balances the frame and secures the glasses on the wearer’s head by resting over the left ear.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for use.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame body of the eyeglasses, made of polycarbonate plastic. It holds the lenses and connects to both temple arms.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses, maintains the optical alignment, and provides the main structural integrity of the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central support structure for the entire eyeglass assembly.
